summary: CLI tool that delegates coding tasks to separate AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, etc.), allowing developers to review diffs and commit changes themselves as a human-in-the-loop reviewer.
usecases: Parallel execution of multiple AI coding agents for different features or bug fixes
Code review workflow where AI implements changes and human reviews the diff before merge
Enforcing commit standards and security reviews while leveraging AI implementation speed
ideas: CI/CD integration to auto-spawn agents for issue triage and fix generation
Automated test execution after agent implementation before diff presentation
Custom agent personas specialized in frontend, backend, or security domains
